# Mr. Chartist type: licences

This file covers three things: the fonts, the type system document and its tokens, and the code snippets. Each has its own licence.

## 1. The fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1

Mr. Chartist uses three fonts under their Chartist names. Each is a subset or renamed copy of an open font, and each stays under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL).

| Chartist name | Original font | Original copyright | Job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chartist Sans Flex | Google Sans Flex | Copyright 2015 The Google Sans Flex Authors (Google), https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans-flex | Text, menus, labels, numbers, dashboards |
| Chartist Sans | Plus Jakarta Sans | Copyright 2020 The Plus Jakarta Sans Project Authors (Tokotype), https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans | Headings, at 600 |
| Chartist Serif | Instrument Serif | Copyright 2022 The Instrument Serif Project Authors (Instrument), https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif | The one italic accent word |

Symbols that Chartist Sans Flex lacks (arrows, tick, bullet, dagger, primes) may come from a small cut of Inter, Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors, https://github.com/rsms/inter, also under OFL 1.1.

Rules we follow, as the OFL requires:

- **Reserved Font Names.** None of the four original fonts declares a Reserved Font Name in its OFL header (checked 29 October 2026 against the OFL.txt in the Google Fonts repository and the Inter repository). The Chartist names therefore do not use a reserved name.
- **Copyright kept.** Every font file keeps its original copyright notice. Each font folder ships the original `OFL.txt` beside the font file.
- **Marked as modified.** Our copies carry the Chartist family name and a line in the font's description: "Modified by Mr. Chartist (subset and renamed), 2026. Original: <original name> by <original authors>, SIL Open Font License 1.1."
- **Stays OFL.** Our modified copies remain under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Anyone who receives them may use, study, modify and redistribute them under the same licence.
- **Never sold alone.** The fonts are never sold on their own. They are shipped as part of Mr. Chartist websites and documents.

The full licence text is at https://openfontlicense.org and in each font folder's `OFL.txt`.
